column1: What's Behind Your Spiritual Dryness?
column5: Soul Fatigue (you're empty, not far) | Hidden Sin Static | The Dark Night (God is weaning, not leaving) | Distraction Drift | Unprocessed Grief
column6: Names the real reason your quiet times went flat and gives one scripture + one next step instead of generic guilt
column8: Cru "5 Things to Do When God Seems Silent", GotQuestions "God-silent-absent", Soul Shepherding dark-night articles, and Daily She Pursues "4 Reasons You May Be Feeling Far From God" all rank for this; "why do I feel far from God" is a recurring top question per Wholeheartedly Messy / Mission Hills

column1: What Kind of Doubt Are You Actually Having?
column5: Intellectual Doubt | Emotional Doubt | Moral / Volitional Doubt | Relational Doubt (someone hurt you) | Circumstantial Doubt (suffering shook you)
column6: Reframes "I'm losing my faith" into a nameable type so you know how to actually treat it
column8: Os Guinness's intellectual/emotional/moral framework is widely taught (Crossway, Jonathan Morrow, Travis Dickinson, crossexamined.org "most doubts are emotional not intellectual"); 412teens/Ligonier show huge demand for "is it a sin to doubt"

column1: Which Doubting Bible Figure Are You?
column5: Thomas (needs proof) | John the Baptist in prison (are you the one?) | Gideon (lays out a fleece) | The father of Mark 9 (help my unbelief) | Job (demands an answer) | Sarah (laughs in disbelief)
column6: Turns the shame of doubt into "you're in good biblical company" — Thomas, Gideon, John all doubted and were not rejected
column8: TGC "My Comfort in John the Baptist's Doubt", Desiring God "How Doubting Thomas Finds Faith", Abide "5 Biblical Figures Who Turned Doubt into Devotion", Logos "Doubting John" — strong shareable demand around named doubters

column1: Are You Deconstructing or Just Asking Honest Questions?
column5: Healthy Questioning (faith-building) | Deconstruction Toward Rebuilding | Deconstruction Toward Exit | Faith Crisis (pain-driven) | Stuck in the Rubble
column6: Answers the exact question deconstructing 25-45s are Googling at 2am: is this growth or am I leaving?
column8: #deconstruction has ~1.1B views and #exvangelical ~233M on TikTok; iBelieve "Questioning versus Deconstructing", GotQuestions, Carey Nieuwhof "5 Reasons People Are Deconstructing", ACSD all frame the exact distinction

column1: Why Does God Feel Silent Right Now?
column5: You Stopped Listening | He's Speaking Through Scripture (not feelings) | The Dark Night (deliberate withdrawal) | Noise Has Crowded Him Out | He Already Answered, You Didn't Recognize It
column6: Diagnoses the specific reason God feels quiet for YOU and hands you the next move
column8: Cru, Crossway "How to Pray and Hear Back from God", Oswald Chambers "silence of pleasure" widely cited; Abide "Hearing His Whisper"; "why does God feel silent / distant" is a dominant search cluster

column1: Is Your Faith on Autopilot?
column5: Running on Fumes (burnout) | Performance Mode (faking it) | Comfortable Coasting | Numb but Showing Up | Genuinely Resting (it's okay)
column6: Brutally honest self-check for the Christian who shows up, smiles, says the words, and feels nothing
column8: Christian Post "Feel like your faith is on autopilot", Living a Fruitful Life "Active or on Autopilot", iBelieve "Spiritually Burned Out But Still Believe", For The Church "Going Through the Motions" — heavy, recurring content theme

column1: What Stage of the Faith Journey Are You In?
column5: Discovery | Belonging / Discipleship | The Productive Life | The Wall (inward journey) | Outward Love (the far side)
column6: Maps your wrestling onto the famous "Wall" of the Critical Journey so your crisis finally makes sense
column8: Hagberg & Guelich "The Critical Journey" and Fowler "Stages of Faith" are heavily blogged (Becoming Me podcast, Restoring The Heart, 2nd Half Collaborative); "the Wall" is a sticky, shareable concept

column1: Are You in a Dark Night of the Soul?
column5: Yes, the Classic Dark Night | Spiritual Burnout (not the same) | Depression Wearing a Spiritual Mask | A Dry Season (normal) | Conviction You're Avoiding

column8: Soul Shepherding, R.C. Sproul/Ligonier, Catholic.com, Dr. Alison Cook podcast, Testimonio "Dark Night... How to Survive It" — strong demand; Mother Teresa / C.S. Lewis hooks make it shareable

column1: Why Aren't Your Prayers Being Answered?
column5: It's a "Not Yet" | It's a Loving "No" | A Heart Barrier (unforgiveness) | Wrong-Motive Asking | He Answered Differently Than You Asked
column6: Gently names which of the classic reasons fits your situation instead of leaving you feeling ignored
column8: JD Greear "5 Reasons", Billy Graham, GotQuestions "unanswered-prayer", For the Gospel "8 Reasons", Wayne Stiles — massive, durable search demand around "why won't God answer my prayers"

column5: Job (no answer for ages) | Habakkuk (how long, Lord?) | Asaph (Psalm 73 almost slipped) | Hannah (prayed through tears) | Elijah (burned out under the broom tree) | David in the cave
column6: Matches your silent-prayer season to a Bible figure who waited in the dark and survived
column8: Carrubbers / Inspired Scripture on Psalm 88 "When God Is Silent", Franciscan Media "Biblical Laments", "faith is learning to trust God in the dark" widely shared; lament figures are vivid and relatable
